title: A paid session-load record gives each arm's cost at 1, 4 and 8 Haiku 5.5 sessions, with the file reads of one capture
goal: kb/_self/reports/benchmarks.csv holds a session-load record of paid Haiku 5.5 runs, arms A, C and D, phases idle and working, at 1, 4 and 8 sessions at once, 3 reps each, its spend under the cap the operator gave, with the file_reads rows of an fs_usage capture the operator made during one of its runs, and its table in kb/_self/reports/benchmarks.md

run:
import sys
def _fail(t, e, tb, _d=sys.excepthook):
    if issubclass(t, AssertionError):
        print('check failed:', e); sys.exit(1)
    _d(t, e, tb)
sys.excepthook = _fail
import csv, subprocess
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '_tools/benchmarks.py', 'report', '--check'], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=600)
assert p.returncode == 0, ('report --check', p.returncode, p.stdout[-400:])
rows = [r for r in csv.DictReader(open('kb/_self/reports/benchmarks.csv', encoding='utf-8')) if r['scenario'] == 'session-load']
paid = [r for r in rows if 'haiku-5-5' in r['model']]
for arm in 'ACD':
    for case in ('idle all', 'working all', 'idle all x4', 'working all x4', 'idle all x8', 'working all x8'):
        assert [r for r in paid if r['arm'] == arm and r['case'] == case and r['metric'] == 'cpu_s' and r['runs'] == '3'], ('no 3-run paid row', arm, case)
spend = [float(r['value']) for r in rows if r['metric'] == 'spend_usd']
assert spend and max(spend) <= 4, ('no spend row, or a record spent over the $4 cap', spend)
assert [r for r in rows if r['case'] == 'capture all' and r['metric'] == 'file_reads'], 'no file_reads row from a capture beside the record'

gates.question: What may the paid session-load record spend? 234 Haiku 5.5 runs (arms A, C, D; idle and working; 1, 4 and 8 sessions; 3 reps); planning estimate 1 to 2.50 US dollars, the --paid --dry-run plan gives the figure before the start
options: Cap 2 USD, arms A and D only
gates.reason: the operator asked for the full matrix, and the cap stays above the estimate with room for 8-session runs
